outlook:
What Axon Enterprise says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: revenueWe expect revenue of $990 million to $1.01 billion.
  • Fourth quarter 2026: adjusted EBITDAWe expect Adjusted EBITDA of $245 million to $250 million.
  • Full year 2026: revenueOur fourth-quarter revenue guidance implies full-year 2026 revenue of approximately $3.61 billion to $3.63 billion, representing approximately 30% annual growth.
  • Full year 2026: free cash flowWe expect full-year 2026 free cash flow of $350 million to $400 million, modestly below our prior target of $450 million due to our accelerated inventory investment to strengthen product availability and supply chain resilience.
  • Full year 2026: capital expendituresWe expect 2026 CapEx to be in the range of $130 million to $150 million, a decrease from $160 million to $190 million.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 5, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
